lesson.text: Quick memory: what does helping first mean? (Helping without asking for something back.) Today: trust, introductions and mentors.
Find out what people need. The baker needs flour; the farmer needs a spade; the toolmaker needs customers.
Introduce people who can help each other: 'Ana, meet Ivan: he makes spades!' Both win, and both remember you.
Promise only what you can really do, then do it. That's how people come to count on you.
A mentor is someone who teaches you. Ask politely, and say when you could come.
There are many ways to talk: with someone who is deaf, face them, smile, point and show.
Try it in the practice village: introduce people and ask Omar to teach you.

A promise you can't keep in time: put it in order.
items: do it at the new time
exercises.explain: Tell them early, agree a new time, do it.
On time and the truth early build trust.
